description:
## Goal

Remove compatibility models, cutover narratives, and test scaffolding whose replacements already own production behavior. Preserve only concepts with a current producer, consumer, or enforced contract.

## Signal

Each child proves the replacement authority before deletion, adds a regression at the surviving boundary, removes the obsolete model completely, and passes focused tests, the full library suite, fixture matrix where applicable, formatting, workspace checks, and clippy with warnings denied. Compiler-work telemetry must remain unchanged or improve; no compatibility shim or tombstone comment may replace deleted code.

## Strategy

Work from the leaves inward: delete isolated fixture residue, remove lying no-op CLI compatibility, retire the completed cutover narrative and impossible negative sentinels, then finish the dynamic-to-typed telemetry migration after concurrent telemetry changes land. One child is one commit, one close, and one pull request. Temporary worktrees isolate every branch from active recalculator work.

## Boundaries

Per-derivation scheduling remains governed by fz-kdt.68 and is removed only if its measured experiment is refuted. BuildBackendProduct remains outside this epic because its bounded inner-compilation role is intentional and is being revisited by the recalculator work.
title: Retire completed migrations and abandoned compiler concepts
